name: Dr Marcus Squirrell
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Trained in CBT, Eye Movement Reprocessing and Desensitisation (EMDR), ACT, Clinical Hypnotherapy, Sex therapy and medico-legal assessments. Predominantly works with men and members of the LGBTIQ+ community; provides WPATH Evaluations for members of gender diverse community pursuing gender affirming treatment. Research interest in online sexual activity.
specialties: LGBTIQ+, sex therapy, EMDR, WPATH evaluations, gender diverse, men's health, hypnotherapy

name: Matt Borowik
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Matt is an LGBTQI friendly Clinical Psychologist who works with both adults and adolescents. Areas of expertise include depression, anxiety, LGBTQ issues, addiction, bipolar and borderline personality; works within an interpersonal and object relations framework.
specialties: LGBTQ issues, addiction, personality, interpersonal/object relations

name: Callum Thompson
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Supports neurodivergent individuals and people experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma and substance use. Draws on CBT, ACT, CFT and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR); committed to an affirming space for LGBTQIA+ communities.

name: Justin Teh
title: Psychologist
description: Justin is a gender and neurodiversity affirming psychologist. Passionate in supporting individuals within the LGBTQIA+ community and international students who experience anxiety, mood disorders, personality disorders, trauma and interpersonal difficulties. Uses ACT, CBT, DBT.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender affirming, trauma, international students, DBT

name: Dr Anthony Smith
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Works with adult clients; therapeutic approaches include cognitive behaviour therapy, schema therapy and elements of dialectical behaviour therapy. Also adult autism and cognitive assessments.
specialties: schema therapy, CBT, DBT, adult autism assessment

name: Kish Dayananda
title: Consultant Psychologist
description: Treats depressive, anxiety and personality disorders, trauma, work and relationship stressors using ACT, CBT, DBT, IPT and Narrative Therapy. He is an LGBTIQ+ ally and values embracing neurodiversity.
specialties: trauma, personality, LGBTIQ+ ally, first responders

name: Dr Stephanie Dias
title: Clinical Psychologist (Doctor of Clinical Psychology)
description: Supports people through anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship difficulties, identity and self-esteem concerns. Draws on CBT, Mindfulness, ACT and Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for trauma.
